steps.title: Pre-procedure Screening and Scheduling
steps.instruction: Perform medical interview, anamnesis, and physical examination. Analyze chest radiographs and required blood tests (blood count, coagulogram, blood glucose, amylase, triglycerides, total proteins and fractions, total bilirubin and fractions, DHL) to schedule the procedure.

steps.title: Patient Preparation and Consent
steps.instruction: Provide the patient with information about the procedure and obtain a signed informed consent.

steps.title: Venous Access and Blood Collection
steps.instruction: Insert a conventional peripheral intravenous catheter for saline infusion and perform peripheral blood collection into storage tubes.

steps.title: Patient Positioning and Site Preparation
steps.instruction: Position the patient sitting on a bed or on the edge of a chair or bed with head and arms resting on a table.

substeps.instruction: Clean the skin around the procedure site

steps.title: Perform Ultrasound-Guided Thoracentesis
steps.instruction: Perform thoracentesis guided by chest ultrasound while monitoring vital signs and maintaining saline infusion.

substeps.instruction: Collect aliquots of 50 milliliters of pleural fluid for conventional study

steps.title: Pleural Fluid Analysis Request
steps.instruction: Request the following analyses for the collected pleural fluid: global and specific citometry, DHL, total proteins and albumin, cholesterol, triglycerides, glucose, total bilirubin and fractions, amylase, pH, acid fast bacilli smear microscopy, mycobacteria culture (on solid media), Xpert MTB/RIF®, culture for bacteria and fungus, cytopathology, and adenosine deaminase dosage.

steps.title: Perform Pleural Biopsy
steps.instruction: If there are no contraindications, perform a pleural biopsy using a Cope needle.

substeps.instruction: Collect 4 pleural fragments for histopathological study
Collect 2 pleural fragments for acid fast bacilli smear microscopy and mycobacteria culture

steps.title: Specimen Transport
steps.instruction: Send all collected biological specimens to the laboratory within one hour after the procedure.

steps.title: Post-procedure Evaluation
steps.instruction: Request a chest X-ray to evaluate for immediate complications such as pneumothorax, bleeding, or bruising.

substeps.instruction: Release the patient home if no complications are found
Hospitalize the patient if complications are suspected

steps.title: Follow-up Examination
steps.instruction: Schedule a medical examination for the patient two weeks after the procedure to review all exam results.
